command:
cat > /root/ansible/opsbot.yml <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
---
- name: Create opsbot account on node1 with SSH keypair
  hosts: node1
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure opsbot user exists
      raw: id -u opsbot >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsbot
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ensure opsbot .ssh directory exists with correct perms
      raw: mkdir -p /home/opsbot/.ssh && chmod 700 /home/opsbot/.ssh && chown opsbot:opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh
      changed_when: false

    - name: Generate ed25519 keypair for opsbot if missing
      raw: test -f /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 || sudo -u opsbot ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -C opsbot@node1 -f /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519
      changed_when: false

    - name: Fetch opsbot's public key
      raw: cat /home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
      register: node1_opsbot_pubkey
      changed_when: false

    - name: Require key-based auth only for opsbot on node1
      raw: >
        grep -q '^Match User opsbot$' /etc/ssh/sshd_config ||
        printf '\nMatch User opsbot\n    PasswordAuthentication no\n    PubkeyAuthentication yes\n    AuthenticationMethods publickey\n    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no\n' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
      changed_when: false

    - name: Validate sshd config syntax
      raw: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Reload sshd to apply opsbot Match block
      raw: systemctl reload sshd
      changed_when: false

- name: Create opsbot account on node2 and authorize node1's key
  hosts: node2
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure opsbot user exists
      raw: id -u opsbot >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsbot
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ensure opsbot .ssh directory exists with correct perms
      raw: mkdir -p /home/opsbot/.ssh && chmod 700 /home/opsbot/.ssh && chown opsbot:opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh
      changed_when: false

    - name: Authorize node1's opsbot public key
      raw: >
        touch /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys &&
        grep -qF "{{ hostvars['node1'].node1_opsbot_pubkey.stdout_lines[0] }}" /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys ||
        echo "{{ hostvars['node1'].node1_opsbot_pubkey.stdout_lines[0] }}" >> /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
      changed_when: false

    - name: Fix ownership/permissions of authorized_keys
      raw: chmod 600 /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys && chown opsbot:opsbot /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys
      changed_when: false

    - name: Require key-based auth only for opsbot on node2
      raw: >
        grep -q '^Match User opsbot$' /etc/ssh/sshd_config ||
        printf '\nMatch User opsbot\n    PasswordAuthentication no\n    PubkeyAuthentication yes\n    AuthenticationMethods publickey\n    KbdInteractiveAuthentication no\n' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
      changed_when: false

    - name: Validate sshd config syntax
      raw: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Reload sshd to apply opsbot Match block
      raw: systemctl reload sshd
      changed_when: false

- name: Verify opsbot key-based access from node1 to node2
  hosts: node1
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: SSH from node1 as opsbot to node2 as opsbot using key auth
      raw: >
        sudo -u opsbot ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o BatchMode=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey
        opsbot@{{ hostvars['node2'].ansible_host }} 'whoami; hostname'
      register: opsbot_ssh_test
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show verification result
      debug:
        var: opsbot_ssh_test.stdout
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo "Playbook written"; wc -l /root/ansible/opsbot.yml
